newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish currency reserves fall to $21.072 bln April.
newsitem.headline: Polish currency reserves fall to $21.072 bln April.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $22 million in April to $21.072 billion and were $519 million lower than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said net reserves fell $595 million in the January-April period compared to a $1.155 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) APRIL MARCH APRIL 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
